ios.desc:
Welcome to LanguageMe, the revolutionary app designed to let you craft your own language-learning journey. Combining generative AI technology with well-established language learning techniques, LanguageMe helps you master 65 languages by studying the content you want, at the difficulty you choose. 

If you want gamification and cunning retention tricks, find another app... If you want scientifically proven OPTIMAL language learning methods, you're in the right place.

Learning a language is HARD, and so too is LanguageMe. But we want our users to TAKE ON THE CHALLENGE of making their screen time more PRODUCTIVE by learning a language in the most effective way possible!  

Features:

Personalized Learning: Choose the content that matches your interests and the difficulty that matches your needs. Build your own language-learning journey.

Combine Key Learning Methods: Seamlessly integrate comprehensive reading materials with quick, effective flashcards to achieve a balanced and optimal learning experience.

Fundamental Language Learning Principles: Leverage tried-and-try principles of comprehensible input (learning words in context) and spaced repetition (reviewing material at increasing intervals) to ensure efficient and lasting language acquisition.

Text-to-Speech: Perfect your pronunciation with built-in text-to-speech capabilities in 65 languages.

Romanization Support: Easily learn character-based languages with built-in romanization for words (e.g., Pinyin for Chinese, Hiragana for Japanese).


Why LanguageMe?

Customizable Content: Study the topics that interest you at the difficulty level that's right for you.

Integrated Learning Tools: Use both long-form reading and short-form flashcards to enhance your learning experience.

Effective Techniques: Use AI technology to harness scientifically tested language-learning techniques of comprehensible input and spaced repetition.

User-Friendly Interface: Enjoy a seamless and intuitive interface designed to make language learning engaging and fun.

Learn Anytime, Anywhere: Whether you're commuting, travelling, or relaxing at home, LanguageMe AI fits into your lifestyle.


Languages supported:

Albanian, Amharic, Arabic, Armenian, Bengali, Bosnian, Bulgarian, Burmese, Catalan, Chinese, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Estonian, English, Finnish, French, Georgian, German, Greek, Gujarati, Hindi, Hungarian, Icelandic, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Kannada, Kazakh, Korean, Latvian, Lithuanian, Macedonian, Mala

quotes.text:
Attention all language learners! I built an app that allows you to generate reading material according to your language level, then learn that content with spaced-repetition flashcards.

I’m an avid Mandarin learner. For me, I’ve found the two most effective methods to learn vocabulary are:
1. Reading content that I’m interested in and is suitable to my level. 
2. Flashcards that show words in context, and appear at increasing intervals (spaced-repetition).

So I built an app that combines these two methods. Generate a reading about a topic you love -> click words you don’t understand to add them to your flashcards -> study the flashcards -> repeat.

The app uses GPT-4o to generate the readings and flashcards, OpenAI’s TTS to speak them, and OpenAI’s Whisper to track words as readings play. It supports 65 languages.

It’s called “LanguageMe AI” and it’s available on the Apple AppStore. It requires creds to login but no email verification, so feel free to put in anything you like.
